summary: Short kerb at a busy junction with painted islands and a house 8 m away.
reasons: Junction with painted chevrons, no room

drivers.seclusion: Tudor Mews house 8 m from the start; vacant grassy lot opposite the junction side.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs into a signalised junction with painted chevron markings and a slip lane; no room to pull clear of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Arterial junction right beside it; heavy traffic.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this stretch.

sun_shade: Mostly open; trees shade the western end.
